content: Kiara Sen contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding the upcoming expiration of her health policy (HP-453219) on September 30, 2026, expressing concern due to a scheduled surgery in early October. Neha confirmed the expiration date and provided two options: renewing the existing policy for another 12 months or switching to a new plan with enhanced benefits. Neha also attached a renewal brochure with instructions to complete the process online or via phone.

action_items: Choose between renewing the existing policy or switching to a new plan
Complete the renewal process online or via phone before the end of the month
